text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the well wishes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
J-just from a "thank you"? Keep it<n>together! You
still have more to say,<n>don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ungh... uh-huh... Rubae! Wanna party<n>tonight? I put a
lot of tho—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry, but I have a dinner<n>to attend
tonight. This time of year<n>tends to get rather busy,
so I would<n>appreciate it if you'd schedule plans
ahead of time.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All right, then I call dibs on next year!<n>Today one
year from now—all mine,<n>please! There, scheduled!
It's a date!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I cannot make any guarantees, but<n>I'll tell my
butler.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh, she's fine, don't mind her.<n>She's just
really happy. Good for<n>you, Helios!
